name: Music
desc: Play music from your phone via AirPlay

changes.summary: A Disconnect button, and burn-in protection that glides
points: Disconnect: a button below the player ends AirPlay or Bluetooth (Down, then OK)
Burn-in protection moves the screen smoothly instead of a pixel at a time (needs NotaTV 1.0.6)
The Now playing box no longer hides behind Tesla's cars on the home screen (needs NotaTV 1.0.6)
